title: Home behind, stone ahead
daily_life: Stonewake supplies fittings and skilled hands to the Burrow. Visits carry family expectations as well as cargo; Gorilla can arrive as a brother, apprentice or colleague.
timing: All departures still use the east gate, then the exterior ring road turns northwest. The visual route may curve outside the basin; no western Burrow entrance is created.
handoff: Five days is the base loaded-road schedule. Workshop appointments should be set after arrival and rest, not during the last walking block.
story_option: A commission expects Gorilla’s strength to replace a second crew. Eris can refuse that assumption without refusing his help.
production: Use the same packed tools across the five-day sequence. A repaired strap remains repaired; fresh costume changes require laundry or a replacement source.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
